items.title: Native image generation in chat
items.body: Ask for things like "make an image that represents this slide" or "give me an image of a monkey at a keyboard".

items.title: Chat cancellation
items.body: Hit Esc to cancel a generation mid-flow.

items.title: MCP tool calling in Agent mode
items.body: Add any MCP from the Gateway to your slide agent.

items.title: Genie Agents in Agent mode
items.body: Add a Genie Agent to your deck to pull figures from its data into your slides.

items.title: Edit this slide
items.body: In Agent mode, say "make this slide shorter" to change the slide you're looking at.
